questionText:
Which of the following statements are correct in respect of goodwill?
(A) the present value of a firm's anticipated excess earnings
(B) the capitalised value attached to the differential profit capacity of a
business.
(C) goodwill exists only when the firm earns super profits
(D) Any firm that earns normal profits or is incurring losses also has
goodwill.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies that both statements contain factual errors.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Detailed Solution:
1. Statement (A): Goodwill is the present value of a firm's anticipated excess earnings. True.
2. Statement (B): Goodwill is the capitalized value attached to differential profit-earning capacity. True.
3. Statement (C): Goodwill exists only when the firm earns super profits. True, because without excess earnings over normal returns, commercial goodwill is zero.
4. Statement (D): Any firm that earns normal profits or incurs losses also has goodwill. False; a firm with normal returns or losses has zero goodwill.
5. Therefore, (A), (B), and (C) only are correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.

firm :-

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. Statement A: 'A partner took an un-recorded asset, it will be shown the credit side of realization account.' Entry: Partner's Capital A/c Dr. To Realisation A/c. This is TRUE.
2. Statement B: States it will be shown on credit side of partner capital (it is shown on the DEBIT side of capital). False.
3. Statement C: A partner taking a liability is credited to partner capital and debited to realization. False.
4. Statement D: Unrecorded liability taken over is debited to realization. False.
5. Therefore, Statement A is the true (not false) statement.
Hence, option (D) is correct.
